lighter_pitch.prompt: captain: (the lighter in one hand, Lord Puffchester in the other) My lord...
lighter_pitch.//: Story Phase 16 (chapter 205): the captain sells Lord Puffchester the Grand Lighter before Vindicta can perform the ceremonial Fire-Waft. Arguments carry points (each can be made once); every round Vindicta's pressure gauge climbs a notch. Reach 10 first. If the gauge tops out, Garrick calls a procedural recess (the checkpoint) and it starts again with a longer clock. Nothing is random.

arguments.text: It's purple. And gold. Very grand.
No paperwork. Not one page. Ever.

reply: You hold it up. You click it. You click it again.

arguments.text: Nobody has to fart, my lord. NOBODY.
reply: puffchester: (thoughtfully, looking at Vindicta) ...That IS a consideration.

arguments.text: Every click is a little ceremony. Hundreds of them!
Think of Agnes the Second. Page sixty-one.
reply: puffchester: (softening) Do not toast. I wrote it myself.

2: vindicta: GATHERING. Somebody open a porthole. Or don't. I'm not fussy.
3: vindicta: (her crown starting to hum) THE ANCIENT FIRE-WAFT. THE GRAND CEREMONY. ANY. MOMENT. NOW.
4: pete: (diving behind the barricade) CAPTAIN. WHATEVER YOU'RE DOING. DO IT FASTER.

fail: garrick: (leaping up onto a stool) POINT OF ORDER! The Grand Stenchmaster calls a PROCEDURAL RECESS! Pending a review of the... the... the ROOM!
garrick: (to you, in a whisper) You owe me a committee.
Fifteen minutes. Lord Puffchester is still at the window. You've still got the lighter. Start again.
won: A flame. A small, ordinary, steady flame, on the very first click, for the first time in recorded history.
puffchester: (taking it, reverently) It's... it's MECHANICAL.
